effects.title: Hello
effects.summary: The smallest effect: a strip of flat 2D blades along the bottom of the view, swaying in a wave of wind, one instanced draw through the HDR tail, over the page. Every later effect starts from this shape.

scorecard.fallback: A row of SVG blades, or the poster.

effects.title: Fur text
effects.summary: A heading grown over with fur, grass or moss: strands drawn by shells from the letters’ distance field and lit as strands, which the pointer combs over and which slowly stand back up.

scorecard.fallback: The heading in a warm brown with a soft text shadow, or the poster.
useCases: A playful or tactile hero heading
A pet, textile or outdoor brand

effects.title: Grass on the page
effects.summary: Grass growing along the top edges of the page’s own headings, cards and buttons, and along the bottom of the view: it sprouts unevenly and fills in over time or as the page scrolls, sways in a wave of wind, and parts around the pointer.

scorecard.fallback: A CSS strip of grass along each element’s top edge, or nothing.
useCases: A spring or seasonal landing page
A garden centre or sustainability site

effects.title: Grass footer
effects.summary: A strip of grass along the bottom of the page, seen from just above the ground: blades placed, clumped, bent by gusts and culled in compute each frame, then drawn with indirect draws. The pointer parts it.

scorecard.fallback: A row of SVG blades swaying with CSS transforms, or the poster.
useCases: A spring or outdoor landing page

effects.title: Grass growth
effects.summary: A lawn growing in from bare ground as the page scrolls, or over time: patches sprout at their own moments and spread until they meet, each blade rising to its height. It shrinks back the same way.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: patches of lawn coming up through bare soil.
useCases: A "growth" story on a landing page

effects.title: Lawn
effects.summary: A lawn seen from standing height. The pointer brushes a trail through it and a press treads it down; the grass rises back over a few seconds, without bouncing, to exactly upright. A cursor trail with a memory.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: a still of the lawn.
useCases: A garden, landscaping or outdoor-brand section

effects.title: Meadow
effects.summary: A meadow at eye level running to the horizon: tall grass with seed heads and wildflowers, coloured from leaf pigments and lit through the blades when the sun is behind them; gusts and cloud shadows crossing it, pollen in the light, the nearest blades out of focus. The pointer brushes a path that springs back.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: a still of the meadow, or a photograph.
useCases: An outdoor or travel brand hero
A landing page for spring or summer

effects.title: Mowing
effects.summary: A lawn being mown in stripes. The mower cuts the grass and lays it the way it travels; the stripes appear because grass laid away from you shows its lit upper side and grass laid towards you its shaded one. Drag to mow; left alone, it mows by a progress value, as a progress bar.

useCases: A playful progress bar or loader

effects.title: Cherry branch
effects.summary: A cherry branch that grows out across the view, buds and blossoms as the page scrolls, then lets its petals go on the breeze. The branch is grown by space colonisation and tapers by the pipe model; the blossoms open a little out of step on their pedicels, and each fallen petal tumbles as it drifts down.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: the branch in full blossom.
useCases: A Japanese restaurant or tea brand

effects.title: Dewy petals
effects.summary: A macro close-up of a rose's petals beaded with dew, turning slowly under a shallow depth of field: each drop a lens showing a flipped view of the petals round it, with a dark rim, a glint and a crescent of gathered light. The look of a perfume or skincare brand.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: the petals and their dew.

effects.title: A flower opening
effects.summary: One flower opening from the bud on its swaying stem, over time or as the page scrolls: a lily, buttercup, cherry blossom, poppy, rose, camellia, hibiscus, morning glory or daffodil, built from its floral diagram, its petals grown surfaces coloured by their pigments that open as their inner faces outgrow their outer ones.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: the flower half open.

effects.title: Night bloom
effects.summary: A moonflower unfurling at dusk, fast enough to watch: its twisted bud untwists and the long tube flares into a broad white limb folded by five greener bands, pale in the moonlight, seen as dark-adapted eyes see it.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: the moonflower open in the dark.
useCases: An evening or night-time event page

effects.title: A rose
effects.summary: A rose opening from a tight bud, close up and slow: forty petals in a golden-angle spiral, nested shell inside shell in the bud and bowl inside bowl as they open, so none passes through another, their margins rolling back as they spread. Red, pink, white, yellow or peach, from their pigments.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: the rose half open.

effects.title: Sunflowers
effects.summary: Rows of sunflowers against a summer sky whose heads turn to follow the pointer as young sunflowers follow the sun, each a little behind the last, and drift back east when it leaves. Each head is 610 florets in Vogel’s golden-angle spiral, ringed by 34 rays.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: the rows facing the viewer.
useCases: A seed company or farm shop

effects.title: Tulip fields
effects.summary: A Dutch bulb field running to the horizon in beds of one colour each, red, yellow, pink, purple, white and orange from their pigments. The near tulips are whole cups swaying in gusts; the far field is their colour. In the evening they close as the light goes.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: the striped field in sun.
useCases: A travel page for the Netherlands

effects.title: Wildflower meadow
effects.summary: The meadow in flower: ox-eye daisies, buttercups, poppies and cornflowers in drifts through the grass, each drift its own species. The nearest heads are whole flowers from their floral diagrams, swaying and brushed aside on the stems the grass grew; further off they are points of colour, and the drifts tint the far field.

scorecard.fallback: The poster: a still of the meadow in flower, or a photograph.
useCases: A garden centre or seed company
